debate.key_bear_argument: Weak trend strength (ADX 15.05), overbought stochastic conditions, poor money flow confirmation, earnings event risk in 15 days, and crisis macro backdrop (VIX spike, rising dollar, flat yield curve) outweigh technical bullish setup.
